mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.sale_id, i.sku_id, i.quantity, i.shipped_quantity, i.price, i.amount, pr.product_name AS productName, pr.product_code AS productCode, sk.spec_text AS specText FROM shop_erp_sale_item i LEFT JOIN shop_product_sku sk ON sk.id = i.sku_id AND sk.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_product pr ON pr.id = sk.product_id AND pr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE i.sale_id = #{saleId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.id ASC
